server.name: com.google/calendar
server.title: Google Calendar
server.description: See your calendars, events, and free or busy times.

setup.reason: Google only lets in a sign-in app you create in your own Google Cloud project, and these servers are in preview.
steps: Join the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program, which these servers need: https://developers.google.com/workspace/preview
Create or pick a Google Cloud project: https://console.cloud.google.com/projectcreate
Turn on the Google Calendar APIs for that project: https://console.cloud.google.com/flows/enableapi?apiid=calendar-json.googleapis.com,calendarmcp.googleapis.com
Set up the consent screen. Under Audience pick Internal if you can, or External and add yourself as a test user: https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/branding
Under Data Access, add the scopes listed below: https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/scopes
Create a client of type Web application, and add the redirect address below under Authorized redirect URIs: https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients/create
Copy the Client ID and Client secret into the boxes below. One client works for all your Google apps.

setup.reason: Zoom only lets in an app you create on the Zoom App Marketplace.
steps: Sign in to the Zoom App Marketplace as a developer or admin: https://marketplace.zoom.us/
Click Develop, then Build app, choose General app, and click Create.
Under Basic Information, then OAuth Information, paste the redirect address below into OAuth redirect URL.
Under Scopes, add the scopes for the Zoom tools you want, as Zoom's MCP server pages list them.
Under Basic Information, then App Credentials, copy the Client ID and Client Secret into the boxes below.
